description: Cases every renderer of nemar.ic-activity reproduces. For each case, decode files (UTF-8 text), take the store (labels, units, scale and offset per row, digital values rows by samples, rate, and the digest the serving copy publishes or null), compute the window's activations (window.start, window.count samples) with the caps of the registry, or the case's caps in their place, and compare: state, components, rows and factors exactly, time_s exactly, and activations and filtered within tolerance.parity times the component's largest magnitude in expected.activations. Each refusal is refused with word. store_checks give the digest states; channel_types_digests give the RFC 8785 text and SHA-256 of {"channel_types": ...}; coefficients and filter_cases hold the display filter alone, compared within tolerance.parity times the largest magnitude of the input row.
